name: Ryuuzaki Miya
source:
Apartment resident.

Secretary to the president of Tokito Building Service, the company where the main character works. She is a type of career woman who can work hard. She is well-liked within the company.

Recently, she has been suffering from a stalker.

She has been divorced in the past.
